title: High-Value Training Data from Noisy, Diverse Sources
abstract: arXiv:2610.30421v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training state-of-the-art models increasingly requires learning from large, heterogeneous datasets whose examples vary in quality, domain relevance, and source of supervision. Dataweighting---assigning different weights to training examples---offers a general way to control how such data influences training, but learning effective weights at scale remains challenging. We develop a scalable approach to learning dataweights: given a small, high-quality target dataset, we use metagradients through the training process to efficiently optimize training-example weights directly for performance on the target domain. To scale beyond a fixed dataset and model, we learn parametric weighting rules that generalize to new and streaming examples and transfer from smaller models to substantially larger ones. translated_title: 来自嘈杂、多样化来源的高价值训练数据
translated_abstract: 训练最先进的模型越来越需要从大型、异构的数据集中学习，这些数据集中的样本在质量、领域相关性和监督来源上各不相同。数据加权——即为训练样本分配不同权重——提供了一种控制此类数据如何影响训练的通用方法，但在大规模下学习有效的权重仍然具有挑战性。我们开发了一种可扩展的数据权重学习方法：给定一个小型、高质量的目标数据集，我们在整个训练过程中使用元梯度（metagradients），直接针对目标域的性能高效地优化训练样本的权重。为了超越固定的数据集和模型进行扩展，我们学习参数化的加权规则，这些规则可以泛化到新样本和流式样本，并能从小模型迁移到规模大得多的模型。我们研究了奖励建模作为典型的应用场景，其中偏好数据可能是嘈杂的、对抗性的、合成的，或与目标域不匹配的。
tldr: 提出一种基于元梯度的可扩展数据加权方法，通过学习可泛化、可迁移的参数化加权规则，为奖励建模等任务从嘈杂多样的数据源中筛选出高价值训练数据。
en_tdlr: A scalable metagradient-based data weighting method that learns generalizable parametric weighting rules to identify high-value training data from noisy, diverse sources, with transfer to larger models and application to reward modeling.
